title: Journal entry line
description: One line of a journal entry. Lines with the same entry_id form one entry; its debits must equal its credits. A line has a debit or a credit, never both.

account_name.description: Optional, for reading. The number is what counts.

source.description: Where the entry came from: bank statement, invoice, bill, payroll report, adjusting entry.

reference.description: Check number, invoice number or statement line.
